text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I enjoyed a meal with Ryoka Tsurugi
at a cafe with a wonderful atmosphere.
choice_data_list: Their signature curry was absolutely exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, extremely!
The interior has such a refined ambiance, yet the curry is so smooth, rich, and comforting—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It had that classic 'homemade curry' flavor, didn't it?
...Elfie would probably love it too.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to bring her along,
but I suppose that might be difficult right now.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: That's true, lately.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The other day, we posted a short video titled "Dancing with All My Might!",
featuring her dancing at absolute full throttle to maximize her athletic prowess, but――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Partly because it's a new series,
it's garnered massive attention.
――Essentially, it's what they call "going viral."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Thanks to everyone's support, Elfie is in huge demand right now for collab streams and TV appearances.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Her magnetic charm――the allure of the Umamusume named
Sonon Elfie――never ceases to amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Again and again, as many times as it takes.
choice_data_list: You two have known each other for years, right?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes. It all started when our company approached her about appearing in a commercial, back when she was gaining traction as an athletic UmaTuber.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
One thing led to another, and she ended up
officially signing an exclusive contract with our agency—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I ended up taking charge of
her production and management.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...It's strange. Ever since then, every single day has been so rich and full—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The day we signed our contract feels as though
it was only yesterday, yet also an eternity ago.
choice_data_list: Ah... I get what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that something like what your Umamusume trainees are to you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Still, indeed... I hope I can offer at least that much
support. Especially seeing how devotedly you work.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, which is why... right now, I feel so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Like a true professional, she acts lively as usual during filming and such, but――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Elfie seems to have a lot of fatigue building up.
Lately, she's been... furrowing her brows with that troubled look more and more.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I tried taking measures in my own way,
but it doesn't seem to have improved much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to cheer up your precious partner...
I understand that feeling all too well.
Wanting to be of help, I asked further.
choice_data_list: By the way, what kind of countermeasure is it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, umm――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We used to eat together about once a week,
or have video watch parties at my place—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Whenever our meetings got too lively and carried away,
we'd even end up having them stay the night over at my place.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I've suspended that for now. She's already buried in work as it is, so I wanted her to have more time to enjoy her private life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a rational decision, true to her nature. But……
Just as she cares for her partner, her partner surely
cares deeply for Ryoka Tsurugi, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending my days alongside <chrname>...
There are times when I certainly feel that way too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's surely why, for Sonon Elfie, that very time was—
choice_data_list: Spending time with you is what's truly important, Ms. Tsurugi.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Tsurugi-san, thank you so much for your hard work today!! Um, well then... I'll be heading out now!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Only if you're up for it, of course...
Do you want to come over to my place tonight?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Also, tomorrow before work,
there's a cafe I'd love to visit with you.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere you'd like...
A café that serves delicious curry.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Yes, Ms. Tsurugi!!
Let's go! I'm going! Please let me come along!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I received an email from Ryoka Tsurugi
reporting that Sonon Elfie had made a full recovery,
along with her deepest thanks.
